verdict.rationale: Several mechanisms give an engineering lead some control over when changes land. The CLI can be installed at a pinned version (ultrametric@0.4.1, confirmed by the hands-on sweep), and `init` writes skill files locally after a dry-run preview. Those files can be committed to share a fixed setup with the team, and hosted process guides can be retrieved at a specific integer version. However, these are piecemeal; missing for 10: a lockfile or manifest tying skills and process versions together, documentation of default update behavior (e.g., whether MCP/hosted guide retrieval silently serves the latest version), and an explicit guarantee or changelog policy against behind-the-back updates.
